intent: Keep-alive connection pool for one host: hands out an existing idle STCPManager::Socket or opens a new one, and closes sockets idle past a timeout via a background thread.

objects.name: SSocketPool
objects.role: getSocket()/returnSocket() public API; _timeoutThreadFunc() (prunes expired sockets) and _getAddress() (caches/re-resolves the host address) private helpers

location_fit.note: a thin pooling layer over STCPManager::Socket, belongs beside it

naming_quality.note: consistent `_`-prefixed private members, bare public/const members
